name: sasom
description: Search SASOM, Thailand's marketplace for sneakers, streetwear, watches and collectibles. Returns live brand-new listings with real prices in THB, available sizes, pre-order status and canonical product links.

interface.longDescription:
SASOM is Thailand's marketplace for sneakers, streetwear, watches and collectibles, with every brand-new item verified before it reaches the buyer.

Ask for a product and a budget and SASOM returns live listings: the current item price in Thai baht, the sizes available right now, whether an item ships from stock or is a pre-order with a delivery estimate, and a link to the product page on sasom.co.th.

What it does not do: it never places an order, charges a card or reserves stock. Prices are item prices; shipping and fees are calculated at checkout on SASOM. Availability is a snapshot at the time of the search.
